title.narrative: Blueing The Caspian Sea : Project Preparation Grant

description.narrative:
UNOPS works in support of the preparations for the "Blueing the Caspian Sea" project that seeks to:
Strengthen national and regional capacity to address pollution, including industrial and marine-based contaminants.
Enhance biodiversity conservation through ecosystem-based approaches, sustainable resource management, and cross-border cooperation.
Promote collaborative engagement with stakeholders, including governments, civil society, and international organizations.
